topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I find myself adjusting to the news, the kind that makes the walls of the room feel a bit more distant. They’ve moved me to a different department, a new set of faces, a fresh stack of files to sort through. It’s not that the old department was a cozy nest, but familiarity has its own silent rhythm. Now, I’m expected to harmonize with a different tune, a new set of expectations. The instructions are clear, the path laid out, but the air feels charged with an unforeseen current. I suppose it’s time to recalibrate, to find the pulse of this new environment. They say change is the only constant, but one can’t help but notice the shift in the wind.
